answer: A payout is split so that 51% arrives at settlement and the rest over 7 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The island schedule is applied in relic and willow exposes each instalment. An hostile operator therefore cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 3887 identities would post 2380 proofs and burn roughly 68 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
